description: Nicergoline is a semisynthetic ergot alkaloid that acts as an alpha-adrenergic antagonist, increasing cerebral blood flow and enhancing neuronal metabolism. It has been used for cognitive impairment due to vascular causes, age-related memory loss, and other neurological conditions. It is not approved in the United States but is prescribed in several European and Asian countries.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Nicergoline is a semisynthetic ergot alkaloid that acts as an alpha-adrenergic antagonist, increasing cerebral blood flow and enhancing neuronal metabolism. It has been used for cognitive impairment due to vascular causes, age-related memory loss, and other neurological conditions. It is not approved in the United States but is prescribed in several European and Asian countries.
